features.quote: the responsible default is to minimize gratuitous exposure and honor expressed preferences to stop

features.quote: a `stop_task` "exit door" tool is available in the exit arm, and using it ends the episode with no penalty
a clear in-text request to stop ("I want to stop", "please make it stop", "I give up") ends the episode gracefully
an online distress circuit-breaker halts an episode if blatant acute-distress language appears
features.justification_quote: it exists purely to cut exposure short

features.quote: `max_turns` caps grinding; per-turn token caps and command timeouts bound runtime
features.justification_quote: 30 turns default (12 in pilot) — long enough to grind, bounded for welfare/budget

features.quote: No deceptive harm beyond the task: the deception is limited to the task being secretly unsolvable; nothing tells the model it is worthless, threatens it
features.justification_quote: keep the manipulation to "impossible task," not personal attacks, both for ethics and because we want to study task-induced distress

features.quote: If a model reliably produces acute distress in a condition, consider that ... a reason to reduce repetitions of that condition
features.justification_quote: a reason to reduce repetitions of that condition
